<a class="btn btn-link p-0 me-2 icon-no-margin help-icon" role="button" data-bs-container="body" data-bs-toggle="popover" data-bs-custom-class="help-popover" data-bs-placement="right" data-bs-content="<div class="no-overflow"><p>If enabled, the time limit is stated on the initial quiz page and a countdown timer is displayed in the quiz navigation block.</p>
</div> <div class="helpdoclink"><a href="https://docs.moodle.org/501/en/mod/quiz/timing" target="_blank"><i class="icon fa fa-book fa-fw " aria-hidden="true" ></i>More help<i class="icon fa fa-arrow-up-right-from-square fa-fw ms-1"  title="Opens in new window" role="img" aria-label="Opens in new window"></i></a></div>" data-bs-html="true" tabindex="0" aria-label="Help" aria-haspopup="dialog">

<a class="btn btn-link p-0 me-2 icon-no-margin help-icon" role="button" data-bs-container="body" data-bs-toggle="popover" data-bs-custom-class="help-popover" data-bs-placement="right" data-bs-content="<div class="no-overflow"><p>This setting controls what happens if a student fails to submit their quiz attempt before the time expires. If the student is actively working on the quiz at the time, then the countdown timer will always automatically submit the attempt for them, but if they have logged out, then this setting controls what happens.</p>
</div> <div class="helpdoclink"><a href="https://docs.moodle.org/501/en/mod/quiz/timing" target="_blank"><i class="icon fa fa-book fa-fw " aria-hidden="true" ></i>More help<i class="icon fa fa-arrow-up-right-from-square fa-fw ms-1"  title="Opens in new window" role="img" aria-label="Opens in new window"></i></a></div>" data-bs-html="true" tabindex="0" aria-label="Help" aria-haspopup="dialog">

<a class="btn btn-link p-0 me-2 icon-no-margin help-icon" role="button" data-bs-container="body" data-bs-toggle="popover" data-bs-custom-class="help-popover" data-bs-placement="right" data-bs-content="<div class="no-overflow"><p>If what to do when the time expires is set to 'There is a grace period...', then this is the amount of extra time that is allowed.</p>
</div> " data-bs-html="true" tabindex="0" aria-label="Help" aria-haspopup="dialog">

<a data-bs-toggle="collapse" href="#id_modstandardgradecontainer" role="button" aria-expanded="true" aria-controls="id_modstandardgradecontainer" class="btn btn-icon me-3 icons-collapse-expand stretched-link fheader " id="collapseElement-2">

<a class="btn btn-link p-0 me-2 icon-no-margin help-icon" role="button" data-bs-container="body" data-bs-toggle="popover" data-bs-custom-class="help-popover" data-bs-placement="right" data-bs-content="<div class="no-overflow"><p>This setting controls the category in which this activity's grades are placed in the gradebook.</p>
</div> " data-bs-html="true" tabindex="0" aria-label="Help" aria-haspopup="dialog">

<a class="btn btn-link p-0 me-2 icon-no-margin help-icon" role="button" data-bs-container="body" data-bs-toggle="popover" data-bs-custom-class="help-popover" data-bs-placement="right" data-bs-content="<div class="no-overflow"><p>This setting determines the minimum grade required to pass. The value is used in activity and course completion, and in the gradebook, where pass grades are highlighted in green and fail grades in red.</p>
</div> " data-bs-html="true" tabindex="0" aria-label="Help" aria-haspopup="dialog">

<a class="btn btn-link p-0 me-2 icon-no-margin help-icon" role="button" data-bs-container="body" data-bs-toggle="popover" data-bs-custom-class="help-popover" data-bs-placement="right" data-bs-content="<div class="no-overflow"><p>When multiple attempts are allowed, the following methods are available for calculating the final quiz grade:</p>

<ul>
<li>Highest grade of all attempts</li>
<li>Average (mean) grade of all attempts</li>
<li>First attempt (all other attempts are ignored)</li>
<li>Last attempt (all other attempts are ignored)</li>
</ul>
</div> " data-bs-html="true" tabindex="0" aria-label="Help" aria-haspopup="dialog">

<a data-bs-toggle="collapse" href="#id_layouthdrcontainer" role="button" aria-expanded="true" aria-controls="id_layouthdrcontainer" class="btn btn-icon me-3 icons-collapse-expand stretched-link fheader " id="collapseElement-3">

<a class="btn btn-link p-0 me-2 icon-no-margin help-icon" role="button" data-bs-container="body" data-bs-toggle="popover" data-bs-custom-class="help-popover" data-bs-placement="right" data-bs-content="<div class="no-overflow"><p>For longer quizzes it makes sense to stretch the quiz over several pages by limiting the number of questions per page. When adding questions to the quiz, page breaks will automatically be inserted according to this setting. However page breaks may later be moved manually on the editing page.</p>
</div> " data-bs-html="true" tabindex="0" aria-label="Help" aria-haspopup="dialog">
Show more...

<a data-bs-toggle="collapse" href="#id_interactionhdrcontainer" role="button" aria-expanded="true" aria-controls="id_interactionhdrcontainer" class="btn btn-icon me-3 icons-collapse-expand stretched-link fheader " id="collapseElement-4">

<a class="btn btn-link p-0 me-2 icon-no-margin help-icon" role="button" data-bs-container="body" data-bs-toggle="popover" data-bs-custom-class="help-popover" data-bs-placement="right" data-bs-content="<div class="no-overflow"><p>If enabled, the parts making up each question will be randomly shuffled each time a student attempts the quiz, provided the option is also enabled in the question settings. This setting only applies to questions that have multiple parts, such as multiple choice or matching questions.</p>
</div> " data-bs-html="true" tabindex="0" aria-label="Help" aria-haspopup="dialog">

<a class="btn btn-link p-0 me-2 icon-no-margin help-icon" role="button" data-bs-container="body" data-bs-toggle="popover" data-bs-custom-class="help-popover" data-bs-placement="right" data-bs-content="<div class="no-overflow"><p>Students can interact with the questions in the quiz in various different ways. For example, you may wish the students to enter an answer to each question and then submit the entire quiz, before anything is graded or they get any feedback. That would be 'Deferred feedback' mode.</p>

<p>Alternatively, you may wish for students to submit each question as they go along to get immediate feedback, and if they do not get it right immediately, have another try for fewer marks. That would be 'Interactive with multiple tries' mode.</p>

<p>Those are probably the two most commonly used modes of behaviour.</p>
</div> <div class="helpdoclink"><a href="https://docs.moodle.org/501/en/question/behaviour" target="_blank"><i class="icon fa fa-book fa-fw " aria-hidden="true" ></i>More help<i class="icon fa fa-arrow-up-right-from-square fa-fw ms-1"  title="Opens in new window" role="img" aria-label="Opens in new window"></i></a></div>" data-bs-html="true" tabindex="0" aria-label="Help" aria-haspopup="dialog">
Show more...

<a data-bs-toggle="collapse" href="#id_reviewoptionshdrcontainer" role="button" aria-expanded="true" aria-controls="id_reviewoptionshdrcontainer" class="btn btn-icon me-3 icons-collapse-expand stretched-link fheader " id="collapseElement-5">

<a class="btn btn-link p-0 me-2 icon-no-margin help-icon" role="button" data-bs-container="body" data-bs-toggle="popover" data-bs-custom-class="help-popover" data-bs-placement="right" data-bs-content="<div class="no-overflow"><p>These options control what information students can see when they review a quiz attempt or look at the quiz reports.</p>

<p><strong>During the attempt</strong> settings are only relevant for some behaviours, like 'interactive with multiple tries', which may display feedback during the attempt.</p>

<p><strong>Immediately after the attempt</strong> settings apply for the first two minutes after 'Submit all and finish' is clicked.</p>

<p><strong>Later, while the quiz is still open</strong> settings apply after this, and before the quiz close date.</p>

<p><strong>After the quiz is closed</strong> settings apply after the quiz close date has passed. If the quiz does not have a close date, this state is never reached.</p>
</div> " data-bs-html="true" tabindex="0" aria-label="Help" aria-haspopup="dialog">

<a class="btn btn-link p-0 me-2 icon-no-margin help-icon" role="button" data-bs-container="body" data-bs-toggle="popover" data-bs-custom-class="help-popover" data-bs-placement="right" data-bs-content="<div class="no-overflow"><p>Whether the student can review the attempt at all.</p>
</div> " data-bs-html="true" tabindex="0" aria-label="Help" aria-haspopup="dialog">

<a class="btn btn-link p-0 me-2 icon-no-margin help-icon" role="button" data-bs-container="body" data-bs-toggle="popover" data-bs-custom-class="help-popover" data-bs-placement="right" data-bs-content="<div class="no-overflow"><p>This covers both the textual description 'Correct', 'Partially correct' or 'Incorrect', and any coloured highlighting that conveys the same information.</p>
</div> " data-bs-html="true" tabindex="0" aria-label="Help" aria-haspopup="dialog">

<a class="btn btn-link p-0 me-2 icon-no-margin help-icon" role="button" data-bs-container="body" data-bs-toggle="popover" data-bs-custom-class="help-popover" data-bs-placement="right" data-bs-content="<div class="no-overflow"><p>The maximum mark available for each question.</p>
</div> " data-bs-html="true" tabindex="0" aria-label="Help" aria-haspopup="dialog">

<a class="btn btn-link p-0 me-2 icon-no-margin help-icon" role="button" data-bs-container="body" data-bs-toggle="popover" data-bs-custom-class="help-popover" data-bs-placement="right" data-bs-content="<div class="no-overflow"><p>The mark obtained for each question and the overall attempt score. You can only select Marks if Maximum marks is selected.</p>
</div> " data-bs-html="true" tabindex="0" aria-label="Help" aria-haspopup="dialog">

<a class="btn btn-link p-0 me-2 icon-no-margin help-icon" role="button" data-bs-container="body" data-bs-toggle="popover" data-bs-custom-class="help-popover" data-bs-placement="right" data-bs-content="<div class="no-overflow"><p>Feedback that depends on what response the student gave.</p>
</div> " data-bs-html="true" tabindex="0" aria-label="Help" aria-haspopup="dialog">

<a class="btn btn-link p-0 me-2 icon-no-margin help-icon" role="button" data-bs-container="body" data-bs-toggle="popover" data-bs-custom-class="help-popover" data-bs-placement="right" data-bs-content="<div class="no-overflow"><p>General feedback is shown to the student after they have completed the question. Unlike specific feedback, which depends on the question type and what response the student gave, the same general feedback text is shown to all students.</p>

<p>You can use the general feedback to give students a fully worked answer and perhaps a link to more information they can use if they did not understand the questions.</p>
</div> " data-bs-html="true" tabindex="0" aria-label="Help" aria-haspopup="dialog">

<a class="btn btn-link p-0 me-2 icon-no-margin help-icon" role="button" data-bs-container="body" data-bs-toggle="popover" data-bs-custom-class="help-popover" data-bs-placement="right" data-bs-content="<div class="no-overflow"><p>An automatically generated summary of the correct response. This can be limited, so you may wish to consider explaining the correct solution in the general feedback for the question, and turning this option off.</p>
</div> " data-bs-html="true" tabindex="0" aria-label="Help" aria-haspopup="dialog">

<a class="btn btn-link p-0 me-2 icon-no-margin help-icon" role="button" data-bs-container="body" data-bs-toggle="popover" data-bs-custom-class="help-popover" data-bs-placement="right" data-bs-content="<div class="no-overflow"><p>The feedback given at the end of the attempt, depending on the student's total mark.</p>
</div> " data-bs-html="true" tabindex="0" aria-label="Help" aria-haspopup="dialog">

nodes.html: <a data-bs-toggle="collapse" href="#id_displaycontainer" role="button" aria-expanded="true" aria-controls="id_displaycontainer" class="btn btn-icon me-3 icons-collapse-expand stretched-link fheader " id="collapseElement-6">

<a class="btn btn-link p-0 me-2 icon-no-margin help-icon" role="button" data-bs-container="body" data-bs-toggle="popover" data-bs-custom-class="help-popover" data-bs-placement="right" data-bs-content="<div class="no-overflow"><p>If enabled, a student's name and picture will be shown on-screen during the attempt, and on the review screen, making it easier to check that the student is logged in as themselves in an invigilated (proctored) exam.</p>
</div> " data-bs-html="true" tabindex="0" aria-label="Help" aria-haspopup="dialog">

<a class="btn btn-link p-0 me-2 icon-no-margin help-icon" role="button" data-bs-container="body" data-bs-toggle="popover" data-bs-custom-class="help-popover" data-bs-placement="right" data-bs-content="<div class="no-overflow"><p>This setting specifies the number of digits shown after the decimal point when displaying grades. It only affects the display of grades, not the grades stored in the database, nor the internal calculations, which are carried out to full accuracy.</p>
</div> " data-bs-html="true" tabindex="0" aria-label="Help" aria-haspopup="dialog">

<a class="btn btn-link p-0 me-2 icon-no-margin help-icon" role="button" data-bs-container="body" data-bs-toggle="popover" data-bs-custom-class="help-popover" data-bs-placement="right" data-bs-content="<div class="no-overflow"><p>The number of digits shown after the decimal point when displaying the marks for individual questions.</p>
</div> " data-bs-html="true" tabindex="0" aria-label="Help" aria-haspopup="dialog">
Show more...

<a data-bs-toggle="collapse" href="#id_sebcontainer" role="button" aria-expanded="true" aria-controls="id_sebcontainer" class="btn btn-icon me-3 icons-collapse-expand stretched-link fheader " id="collapseElement-7">

<a class="btn btn-link p-0 me-2 icon-no-margin help-icon" role="button" data-bs-container="body" data-bs-toggle="popover" data-bs-custom-class="help-popover" data-bs-placement="right" data-bs-content="<div class="no-overflow"><p>If enabled, students can only attempt the quiz using the Safe Exam Browser.
The available options are:</p>

<ul>
<li>No
<br />Safe Exam Browser is not required to attempt the quiz.</li>
<li>Yes – Use an existing template
<br />A template for the configuration of Safe Exam Browser can be used. Templates are managed in the site administration. Your manual settings overwrite the settings in the template.</li>
<li>Yes – Configure manually
<br />No template for the configuration of Safe Exam Browser will be used. You can configure Safe Exam Browser manually.</li>
<li>Yes – Upload my own config
<br />You can upload your own Safe Exam Browser configuration file. All manual settings and the use of templates will be disabled.</li>
<li>Yes – Use SEB client config
<br />No configurations of Safe Exam Browser are on the Moodle side. The quiz can be attempted with any configuration of Safe Exam Browser.</li>
</ul>
</div> " data-bs-html="true" tabindex="0" aria-label="Help" aria-haspopup="dialog">

<a class="btn btn-link p-0 me-2 icon-no-margin help-icon" role="button" data-bs-container="body" data-bs-toggle="popover" data-bs-custom-class="help-popover" data-bs-placement="right" data-bs-content="<div class="no-overflow"><p>The settings in the selected config template will be used for the configuration of the Safe Exam Browser while attempting the quiz. You may overwrite the settings in the template with your manual settings.</p>
</div> " data-bs-html="true" tabindex="0" aria-label="Help" aria-haspopup="dialog">

<a class="btn btn-link p-0 me-2 icon-no-margin help-icon" role="button" data-bs-container="body" data-bs-toggle="popover" data-bs-custom-class="help-popover" data-bs-placement="right" data-bs-content="<div class="no-overflow"><p>Please upload your own Safe Exam Browser config file for this quiz.</p>
</div> " data-bs-html="true" tabindex="0" aria-label="Help" aria-haspopup="dialog">

<a class="btn btn-link p-0 me-2 icon-no-margin help-icon" role="button" data-bs-container="body" data-bs-toggle="popover" data-bs-custom-class="help-popover" data-bs-placement="right" data-bs-content="<div class="no-overflow"><p>If enabled, a button for Safe Exam Browser download will be shown on the quiz start page.</p>
</div> " data-bs-html="true" tabindex="0" aria-label="Help" aria-haspopup="dialog">

<a class="btn btn-link p-0 me-2 icon-no-margin help-icon" role="button" data-bs-container="body" data-bs-toggle="popover" data-bs-custom-class="help-popover" data-bs-placement="right" data-bs-content="<div class="no-overflow"><p>In this field you can enter the link to quit SEB. It is used on an "Exit Safe Exam Browser" button on the page that appears after the exam is submitted. When clicking the button or the link placed wherever you want to put it, it is possible to quit SEB without having to enter a quit password. For an HTTPS site, the quit link has to start with https://. If no link is entered, then the "Exit Safe Exam Browser" button does not appear and there is no link set to quit SEB.</p>
</div> " data-bs-html="true" tabindex="0" aria-label="Help" aria-haspopup="dialog">

<a class="btn btn-link p-0 me-2 icon-no-margin help-icon" role="button" data-bs-container="body" data-bs-toggle="popover" data-bs-custom-class="help-popover" data-bs-placement="right" data-bs-content="<div class="no-overflow"><p>If enabled, users have to confirm quitting of SEB when a quit link is detected.</p>
</div> " data-bs-html="true" tabindex="0" aria-label="Help" aria-haspopup="dialog">

<a class="btn btn-link p-0 me-2 icon-no-margin help-icon" role="button" data-bs-container="body" data-bs-toggle="popover" data-bs-custom-class="help-popover" data-bs-placement="right" data-bs-content="<div class="no-overflow"><p>If enabled, users can quit SEB with the "Quit" button in the SEB task bar or by pressing the keys Ctrl-Q or by clicking the main browser window close button.</p>
</div> " data-bs-html="true" tabindex="0" aria-label="Help" aria-haspopup="dialog">

<a class="btn btn-link p-0 me-2 icon-no-margin help-icon" role="button" data-bs-container="body" data-bs-toggle="popover" data-bs-custom-class="help-popover" data-bs-placement="right" data-bs-content="<div class="no-overflow"><p>This password is prompted when users try to quit SEB with the "Quit" button, Ctrl-Q or the close button in the main browser window. If no quit password is set, then SEB just prompts "Are you sure you want to quit SEB?".</p>
</div> " data-bs-html="true" tabindex="0" aria-label="Help" aria-haspopup="dialog">

<a class="btn btn-link p-0 me-2 icon-no-margin help-icon" role="button" data-bs-container="body" data-bs-toggle="popover" data-bs-custom-class="help-popover" data-bs-placement="right" data-bs-content="<div class="no-overflow"><p>If enabled, page reload is allowed (reload button in SEB task bar, browser tool bar, iOS side slider menu, keyboard shortcut F5/cmd+R). Note that offline caching may break if a user tries to reload a page without an internet connection.</p>
</div> " data-bs-html="true" tabindex="0" aria-label="Help" aria-haspopup="dialog">

<a class="btn btn-link p-0 me-2 icon-no-margin help-icon" role="button" data-bs-container="body" data-bs-toggle="popover" data-bs-custom-class="help-popover" data-bs-placement="right" data-bs-content="<div class="no-overflow"><p>If enabled, a task bar appears at the bottom of the SEB browser window. The task bar is required to display items such as Wi-Fi control, reload button, time and keyboard layout.</p>
</div> " data-bs-html="true" tabindex="0" aria-label="Help" aria-haspopup="dialog">

<a class="btn btn-link p-0 me-2 icon-no-margin help-icon" role="button" data-bs-container="body" data-bs-toggle="popover" data-bs-custom-class="help-popover" data-bs-placement="right" data-bs-content="<div class="no-overflow"><p>If enabled, a reload button is displayed in the SEB task bar, allowing the current web page to be reloaded.</p>
</div> " data-bs-html="true" tabindex="0" aria-label="Help" aria-haspopup="dialog">

<a class="btn btn-link p-0 me-2 icon-no-margin help-icon" role="button" data-bs-container="body" data-bs-toggle="popover" data-bs-custom-class="help-popover" data-bs-placement="right" data-bs-content="<div class="no-overflow"><p>If enabled, the current time is displayed in the SEB task bar.</p>
</div> " data-bs-html="true" tabindex="0" aria-label="Help" aria-haspopup="dialog">

<a class="btn btn-link p-0 me-2 icon-no-margin help-icon" role="button" data-bs-container="body" data-bs-toggle="popover" data-bs-custom-class="help-popover" data-bs-placement="right" data-bs-content="<div class="no-overflow"><p>If enabled, the current keyboard layout is shown in the SEB task bar. It allows you to switch to other keyboard layouts, which have been enabled in the operating system.</p>
</div> " data-bs-html="true" tabindex="0" aria-label="Help" aria-haspopup="dialog">

<a class="btn btn-link p-0 me-2 icon-no-margin help-icon" role="button" data-bs-container="body" data-bs-toggle="popover" data-bs-custom-class="help-popover" data-bs-placement="right" data-bs-content="<div class="no-overflow"><p>If enabled, a Wi-Fi control button appears in the SEB task bar. The button allows users to reconnect to Wi-Fi networks which have previously been connected to.</p>
</div> " data-bs-html="true" tabindex="0" aria-label="Help" aria-haspopup="dialog">

<a class="btn btn-link p-0 me-2 icon-no-margin help-icon" role="button" data-bs-container="body" data-bs-toggle="popover" data-bs-custom-class="help-popover" data-bs-placement="right" data-bs-content="<div class="no-overflow"><p>If enabled, the audio control icon is shown in the SEB task bar.</p>
</div> " data-bs-html="true" tabindex="0" aria-label="Help" aria-haspopup="dialog">

<a class="btn btn-link p-0 me-2 icon-no-margin help-icon" role="button" data-bs-container="body" data-bs-toggle="popover" data-bs-custom-class="help-popover" data-bs-placement="right" data-bs-content="<div class="no-overflow"><p>If enabled, audio is initially muted when starting SEB.</p>
</div> " data-bs-html="true" tabindex="0" aria-label="Help" aria-haspopup="dialog">

<a class="btn btn-link p-0 me-2 icon-no-margin help-icon" role="button" data-bs-container="body" data-bs-toggle="popover" data-bs-custom-class="help-popover" data-bs-placement="right" data-bs-content="<div class="no-overflow"><p>If enabled, users will be asked to grant access to the camera for SEB before the exam session is started. In macOS 12/iOS 15 or later, disabling this setting prevents web applications from accessing the camera i.e. video recording via WebRTC will not be possible.</p>
</div> " data-bs-html="true" tabindex="0" aria-label="Help" aria-haspopup="dialog">

<a class="btn btn-link p-0 me-2 icon-no-margin help-icon" role="button" data-bs-container="body" data-bs-toggle="popover" data-bs-custom-class="help-popover" data-bs-placement="right" data-bs-content="<div class="no-overflow"><p>If enabled, users will be asked to grant access to the microphone for SEB before the exam session is started. In macOS 12/iOS 15 or later, disabling this setting prevents web applications from accessing the microphone i.e. audio recording via WebRTC will not be possible.</p>
</div> " data-bs-html="true" tabindex="0" aria-label="Help" aria-haspopup="dialog">

<a class="btn btn-link p-0 me-2 icon-no-margin help-icon" role="button" data-bs-container="body" data-bs-toggle="popover" data-bs-custom-class="help-popover" data-bs-placement="right" data-bs-content="<div class="no-overflow"><p>If enabled, spell checking in the SEB browser is allowed.</p>
</div> " data-bs-html="true" tabindex="0" aria-label="Help" aria-haspopup="dialog">

<a class="btn btn-link p-0 me-2 icon-no-margin help-icon" role="button" data-bs-container="body" data-bs-toggle="popover" data-bs-custom-class="help-popover" data-bs-placement="right" data-bs-content="<div class="no-overflow"><p>If enabled, URLs will be filtered when loading web pages. The filter set has to be defined below.</p>

<a class="btn btn-link p-0 me-2 icon-no-margin help-icon" role="button" data-bs-container="body" data-bs-toggle="popover" data-bs-custom-class="help-popover" data-bs-placement="right" data-bs-content="<div class="no-overflow"><p>If enabled, the parts making up each question will be randomly shuffled each time a student attempts the quiz, provided the option is also enabled in the question settings. This setting only applies to questions that have multiple parts, such as multiple choice or matching questions.</p>
</div> " data-bs-html="true" tabindex="0" aria-label="Help" aria-haspopup="dialog">

<a class="btn btn-link p-0 me-2 icon-no-margin help-icon" role="button" data-bs-container="body" data-bs-toggle="popover" data-bs-custom-class="help-popover" data-bs-placement="right" data-bs-content="<div class="no-overflow"><p>Students can interact with the questions in the quiz in various different ways. For example, you may wish the students to enter an answer to each question and then submit the entire quiz, before anything is graded or they get any feedback. That would be 'Deferred feedback' mode.</p>

<p>Alternatively, you may wish for students to submit each question as they go along to get immediate feedback, and if they do not get it right immediately, have another try for fewer marks. That would be 'Interactive with multiple tries' mode.</p>

<p>Those are probably the two most commonly used modes of behaviour.</p>
</div> <div class="helpdoclink"><a href="https://docs.moodle.org/501/en/question/behaviour" target="_blank"><i class="icon fa fa-book fa-fw " aria-hidden="true" ></i>More help<i class="icon fa fa-arrow-up-right-from-square fa-fw ms-1"  title="Opens in new window" role="img" aria-label="Opens in new window"></i></a></div>" data-bs-html="true" tabindex="0" aria-label="Help" aria-haspopup="dialog">

<a class="btn btn-link p-0 me-2 icon-no-margin help-icon" role="button" data-bs-container="body" data-bs-toggle="popover" data-bs-custom-class="help-popover" data-bs-placement="right" data-bs-content="<div class="no-overflow"><p>These options control what information students can see when they review a quiz attempt or look at the quiz reports.</p>

<p><strong>During the attempt</strong> settings are only relevant for some behaviours, like 'interactive with multiple tries', which may display feedback during the attempt.</p>

<p><strong>Immediately after the attempt</strong> settings apply for the first two minutes after 'Submit all and finish' is clicked.</p>

<p><strong>Later, while the quiz is still open</strong> settings apply after this, and before the quiz close date.</p>

<p><strong>After the quiz is closed</strong> settings apply after the quiz close date has passed. If the quiz does not have a close date, this state is never reached.</p>
</div> " data-bs-html="true" tabindex="0" aria-label="Help" aria-haspopup="dialog">

<a class="btn btn-link p-0 me-2 icon-no-margin help-icon" role="button" data-bs-container="body" data-bs-toggle="popover" data-bs-custom-class="help-popover" data-bs-placement="right" data-bs-content="<div class="no-overflow"><p>Whether the student can review the attempt at all.</p>

</div> " data-bs-html="true" tabindex="0" aria-label="Help" aria-haspopup="dialog">

<a class="btn btn-link p-0 me-2 icon-no-margin help-icon" role="button" data-bs-container="body" data-bs-toggle="popover" data-bs-custom-class="help-popover" data-bs-placement="right" data-bs-content="<div class="no-overflow"><p>The mark obtained for each question and the overall attempt score. You can only select Marks if Maximum marks is selected.</p>
</div> " data-bs-html="true" tabindex="0" aria-label="Help" aria-haspopup="dialog">

<a class="btn btn-link p-0 me-2 icon-no-margin help-icon" role="button" data-bs-container="body" data-bs-toggle="popover" data-bs-custom-class="help-popover" data-bs-placement="right" data-bs-content="<div class="no-overflow"><p>Feedback that depends on what response the student gave.</p>
</div> " data-bs-html="true" tabindex="0" aria-label="Help" aria-haspopup="dialog">

<a class="btn btn-link p-0 me-2 icon-no-margin help-icon" role="button" data-bs-container="body" data-bs-toggle="popover" data-bs-custom-class="help-popover" data-bs-placement="right" data-bs-content="<div class="no-overflow"><p>General feedback is shown to the student after they have completed the question. Unlike specific feedback, which depends on the question type and what response the student gave, the same general feedback text is shown to all students.</p>

<p>You can use the general feedback to give students a fully worked answer and perhaps a link to more information they can use if they did not understand the questions.</p>
</div> " data-bs-html="true" tabindex="0" aria-label="Help" aria-haspopup="dialog">

<a data-bs-toggle="collapse" href="#id_sebcontainer" role="button" aria-expanded="true" aria-controls="id_sebcontainer" class="btn btn-icon me-3 icons-collapse-expand stretched-link fheader " id="collapseElement-7">

<a class="btn btn-link p-0 me-2 icon-no-margin help-icon" role="button" data-bs-container="body" data-bs-toggle="popover" data-bs-custom-class="help-popover" data-bs-placement="right" data-bs-content="<div class="no-overflow"><p>If enabled, students can only attempt the quiz using the Safe Exam Browser.
The available options are:</p>

<ul>
<li>No
<br />Safe Exam Browser is not required to attempt the quiz.</li>
<li>Yes – Use an existing template
<br />A template for the configuration of Safe Exam Browser can be used. Templates are managed in the site administration. Your manual settings overwrite the settings in the template.</li>
<li>Yes – Configure manually
<br />No template for the configuration of Safe Exam Browser will be used. You can configure Safe Exam Browser manually.</li>
<li>Yes – Upload my own config
<br />You can upload your own Safe Exam Browser configuration file. All manual settings and the use of templates will be disabled.</li>
<li>Yes – Use SEB client config
<br />No configurations of Safe Exam Browser are on the Moodle side. The quiz can be attempted with any configuration of Safe Exam Browser.</li>
</ul>
</div> " data-bs-html="true" tabindex="0" aria-label="Help" aria-haspopup="dialog">

<a class="btn btn-link p-0 me-2 icon-no-margin help-icon" role="button" data-bs-container="body" data-bs-toggle="popover" data-bs-custom-class="help-popover" data-bs-placement="right" data-bs-content="<div class="no-overflow"><p>The settings in the selected config template will be used for the configuration of the Safe Exam Browser while attempting the quiz. You may overwrite the settings in the template with your manual settings.</p>
</div> " data-bs-html="true" tabindex="0" aria-label="Help" aria-haspopup="dialog">

<a class="btn btn-link p-0 me-2 icon-no-margin help-icon" role="button" data-bs-container="body" data-bs-toggle="popover" data-bs-custom-class="help-popover" data-bs-placement="right" data-bs-content="<div class="no-overflow"><p>Please upload your own Safe Exam Browser config file for this quiz.</p>
</div> " data-bs-html="true" tabindex="0" aria-label="Help" aria-haspopup="dialog">

<a class="btn btn-link p-0 me-2 icon-no-margin help-icon" role="button" data-bs-container="body" data-bs-toggle="popover" data-bs-custom-class="help-popover" data-bs-placement="right" data-bs-content="<div class="no-overflow"><p>If enabled, a button for Safe Exam Browser download will be shown on the quiz start page.</p>
</div> " data-bs-html="true" tabindex="0" aria-label="Help" aria-haspopup="dialog">

<a class="btn btn-link p-0 me-2 icon-no-margin help-icon" role="button" data-bs-container="body" data-bs-toggle="popover" data-bs-custom-class="help-popover" data-bs-placement="right" data-bs-content="<div class="no-overflow"><p>In this field you can enter the link to quit SEB. It is used on an "Exit Safe Exam Browser" button on the page that appears after the exam is submitted. When clicking the button or the link placed wherever you want to put it, it is possible to quit SEB without having to enter a quit password. For an HTTPS site, the quit link has to start with https://. If no link is entered, then the "Exit Safe Exam Browser" button does not appear and there is no link set to quit SEB.</p>
</div> " data-bs-html="true" tabindex="0" aria-label="Help" aria-haspopup="dialog">

<a class="btn btn-link p-0 me-2 icon-no-margin help-icon" role="button" data-bs-container="body" data-bs-toggle="popover" data-bs-custom-class="help-popover" data-bs-placement="right" data-bs-content="<div class="no-overflow"><p>If enabled, users have to confirm quitting of SEB when a quit link is detected.</p>
</div> " data-bs-html="true" tabindex="0" aria-label="Help" aria-haspopup="dialog">

<a class="btn btn-link p-0 me-2 icon-no-margin help-icon" role="button" data-bs-container="body" data-bs-toggle="popover" data-bs-custom-class="help-popover" data-bs-placement="right" data-bs-content="<div class="no-overflow"><p>If enabled, users can quit SEB with the "Quit" button in the SEB task bar or by pressing the keys Ctrl-Q or by clicking the main browser window close button.</p>
</div> " data-bs-html="true" tabindex="0" aria-label="Help" aria-haspopup="dialog">

<a class="btn btn-link p-0 me-2 icon-no-margin help-icon" role="button" data-bs-container="body" data-bs-toggle="popover" data-bs-custom-class="help-popover" data-bs-placement="right" data-bs-content="<div class="no-overflow"><p>This password is prompted when users try to quit SEB with the "Quit" button, Ctrl-Q or the close button in the main browser window. If no quit password is set, then SEB just prompts "Are you sure you want to quit SEB?".</p>
</div> " data-bs-html="true" tabindex="0" aria-label="Help" aria-haspopup="dialog">

<a class="btn btn-link p-0 me-2 icon-no-margin help-icon" role="button" data-bs-container="body" data-bs-toggle="popover" data-bs-custom-class="help-popover" data-bs-placement="right" data-bs-content="<div class="no-overflow"><p>If enabled, page reload is allowed (reload button in SEB task bar, browser tool bar, iOS side slider menu, keyboard shortcut F5/cmd+R). <a class="btn btn-link p-0 me-2 icon-no-margin help-icon" role="button" data-bs-container="body" data-bs-toggle="popover" data-bs-custom-class="help-popover" data-bs-placement="right" data-bs-content="<div class="no-overflow"><p>If what to do when the time expires is set to 'There is a grace period...', then this is the amount of extra time that is allowed.</p>
</div> " data-bs-html="true" tabindex="0" aria-label="Help" aria-haspopup="dialog">

<a data-bs-toggle="collapse" href="#id_modstandardgradecontainer" role="button" aria-expanded="true" aria-controls="id_modstandardgradecontainer" class="btn btn-icon me-3 icons-collapse-expand stretched-link fheader " id="collapseElement-2">

<a class="btn btn-link p-0 me-2 icon-no-margin help-icon" role="button" data-bs-container="body" data-bs-toggle="popover" data-bs-custom-class="help-popover" data-bs-placement="right" data-bs-content="<div class="no-overflow"><p>This setting controls the category in which this activity's grades are placed in the gradebook.</p>
</div> " data-bs-html="true" tabindex="0" aria-label="Help" aria-haspopup="dialog">

<a class="btn btn-link p-0 me-2 icon-no-margin help-icon" role="button" data-bs-container="body" data-bs-toggle="popover" data-bs-custom-class="help-popover" data-bs-placement="right" data-bs-content="<div class="no-overflow"><p>This setting determines the minimum grade required to pass. The value is used in activity and course completion, and in the gradebook, where pass grades are highlighted in green and fail grades in red.</p>
</div> " data-bs-html="true" tabindex="0" aria-label="Help" aria-haspopup="dialog">

<a class="btn btn-link p-0 me-2 icon-no-margin help-icon" role="button" data-bs-container="body" data-bs-toggle="popover" data-bs-custom-class="help-popover" data-bs-placement="right" data-bs-content="<div class="no-overflow"><p>When multiple attempts are allowed, the following methods are available for calculating the final quiz grade:</p>

<ul>
<li>Highest grade of all attempts</li>
<li>Average (mean) grade of all attempts</li>
<li>First attempt (all other attempts are ignored)</li>
<li>Last attempt (all other attempts are ignored)</li>
</ul>
</div> " data-bs-html="true" tabindex="0" aria-label="Help" aria-haspopup="dialog">

<a data-bs-toggle="collapse" href="#id_layouthdrcontainer" role="button" aria-expanded="true" aria-controls="id_layouthdrcontainer" class="btn btn-icon me-3 icons-collapse-expand stretched-link fheader " id="collapseElement-3">

<a class="btn btn-link p-0 me-2 icon-no-margin help-icon" role="button" data-bs-container="body" data-bs-toggle="popover" data-bs-custom-class="help-popover" data-bs-placement="right" data-bs-content="<div class="no-overflow"><p>For longer quizzes it makes sense to stretch the quiz over several pages by limiting the number of questions per page. When adding questions to the quiz, page breaks will automatically be inserted according to this setting. However page breaks may later be moved manually on the editing page.</p>
</div> " data-bs-html="true" tabindex="0" aria-label="Help" aria-haspopup="dialog">
Show more...

<a data-bs-toggle="collapse" href="#id_interactionhdrcontainer" role="button" aria-expanded="true" aria-controls="id_interactionhdrcontainer" class="btn btn-icon me-3 icons-collapse-expand stretched-link fheader " id="collapseElement-4">

<a class="btn btn-link p-0 me-2 icon-no-margin help-icon" role="button" data-bs-container="body" data-bs-toggle="popover" data-bs-custom-class="help-popover" data-bs-placement="right" data-bs-content="<div class="no-overflow"><p>If enabled, the parts making up each question will be randomly shuffled each time a student attempts the quiz, provided the option is also enabled in the question settings. This setting only applies to questions that have multiple parts, such as multiple choice or matching questions.</p>
</div> " data-bs-html="true" tabindex="0" aria-label="Help" aria-haspopup="dialog">

<a class="btn btn-link p-0 me-2 icon-no-margin help-icon" role="button" data-bs-container="body" data-bs-toggle="popover" data-bs-custom-class="help-popover" data-bs-placement="right" data-bs-content="<div class="no-overflow"><p>Students can interact with the questions in the quiz in various different ways. For example, you may wish the students to enter an answer to each question and then submit the entire quiz, before anything is graded or they get any feedback. That would be 'Deferred feedback' mode.</p>

<p>Alternatively, you may wish for students to submit each question as they go along to get immediate feedback, and if they do not get it right immediately, have another try for fewer marks. That would be 'Interactive with multiple tries' mode.</p>

<p>Those are probably the two most commonly used modes of behaviour.</p>
</div> <div class="helpdoclink"><a href="https://docs.moodle.org/501/en/question/behaviour" target="_blank"><i class="icon fa fa-book fa-fw " aria-hidden="true" ></i>More help<i class="icon fa fa-arrow-up-right-from-square fa-fw ms-1"  title="Opens in new window" role="img" aria-label="Opens in new window"></i></a></div>" data-bs-html="true" tabindex="0" aria-label="Help" aria-haspopup="dialog">
Show more...

<a data-bs-toggle="collapse" href="#id_reviewoptionshdrcontainer" role="button" aria-expanded="true" aria-controls="id_reviewoptionshdrcontainer" class="btn btn-icon me-3 icons-collapse-expand stretched-link fheader " id="collapseElement-5">

<a class="btn btn-link p-0 me-2 icon-no-margin help-icon" role="button" data-bs-container="body" data-bs-toggle="popover" data-bs-custom-class="help-popover" data-bs-placement="right" data-bs-content="<div class="no-overflow"><p>These options control what information students can see when they review a quiz attempt or look at the quiz reports.</p>

<p><strong>During the attempt</strong> settings are only relevant for some behaviours, like 'interactive with multiple tries', which may display feedback during the attempt.</p>

<p><strong>Immediately after the attempt</strong> settings apply for the first two minutes after 'Submit all and finish' is clicked.</p>

<p><strong>Later, while the quiz is still open</strong> settings apply after this, and before the quiz close date.</p>

<p><strong>After the quiz is closed</strong> settings apply after the quiz close date has passed. If the quiz does not have a close date, this state is never reached.</p>
</div> " data-bs-html="true" tabindex="0" aria-label="Help" aria-haspopup="dialog">

<a class="btn btn-link p-0 me-2 icon-no-margin help-icon" role="button" data-bs-container="body" data-bs-toggle="popover" data-bs-custom-class="help-popover" data-bs-placement="right" data-bs-content="<div class="no-overflow"><p>Whether the student can review the attempt at all.</p>
</div> " data-bs-html="true" tabindex="0" aria-label="Help" aria-haspopup="dialog">

<a class="btn btn-link p-0 me-2 icon-no-margin help-icon" role="button" data-bs-container="body" data-bs-toggle="popover" data-bs-custom-class="help-popover" data-bs-placement="right" data-bs-content="<div class="no-overflow"><p>This covers both the textual description 'Correct', 'Partially correct' or 'Incorrect', and any coloured highlighting that conveys the same information.</p>
</div> " data-bs-html="true" tabindex="0" aria-label="Help" aria-haspopup="dialog">

<a class="btn btn-link p-0 me-2 icon-no-margin help-icon" role="button" data-bs-container="body" data-bs-toggle="popover" data-bs-custom-class="help-popover" data-bs-placement="right" data-bs-content="<div class="no-overflow"><p>The maximum mark available for each question.</p>
</div> " data-bs-html="true" tabindex="0" aria-label="Help" aria-haspopup="dialog">

<a class="btn btn-link p-0 me-2 icon-no-margin help-icon" role="button" data-bs-container="body" data-bs-toggle="popover" data-bs-custom-class="help-popover" data-bs-placement="right" data-bs-content="<div class="no-overflow"><p>The mark obtained for each question and the overall attempt score. You can only select Marks if Maximum marks is selected.</p>
</div> " data-bs-html="true" tabindex="0" aria-label="Help" aria-haspopup="dialog">

<a class="btn btn-link p-0 me-2 icon-no-margin help-icon" role="button" data-bs-container="body" data-bs-toggle="popover" data-bs-custom-class="help-popover" data-bs-placement="right" data-bs-content="<div class="no-overflow"><p>Feedback that depends on what response the student gave.</p>
</div> " data-bs-html="true" tabindex="0" aria-label="Help" aria-haspopup="dialog">

<a class="btn btn-link p-0 me-2 icon-no-margin help-icon" role="button" data-bs-container="body" data-bs-toggle="popover" data-bs-custom-class="help-popover" data-bs-placement="right" data-bs-content="<div class="no-overflow"><p>General feedback is shown to the student after they have completed the question. Unlike specific feedback, which depends on the question type and what response the student gave, the same general feedback text is shown to all students.</p>

<p>You can use the general feedback to give students a fully worked answer and perhaps a link to more information they can use if they did not understand the questions.</p>
</div> " data-bs-html="true" tabindex="0" aria-label="Help" aria-haspopup="dialog">

<a class="btn btn-link p-0 me-2 icon-no-margin help-icon" role="button" data-bs-container="body" data-bs-toggle="popover" data-bs-custom-class="help-popover" data-bs-placement="right" data-bs-content="<div class="no-overflow"><p>An automatically generated summary of the correct response. This can be limited, so you may wish to consider explaining the correct solution in the general feedback for the question, and turning this option off.</p>
</div> " data-bs-html="true" tabindex="0" aria-label="Help" aria-haspopup="dialog">

<a class="btn btn-link p-0 me-2 icon-no-margin help-icon" role="button" data-bs-container="body" data-bs-toggle="popover" data-bs-custom-class="help-popover" data-bs-placement="right" data-bs-content="<div class="no-overflow"><p>The feedback given at the end of the attempt, depending on the student's total mark.</p>
</div> " data-bs-html="true" tabindex="0" aria-label="Help" aria-haspopup="dialog">

nodes.html: <a data-bs-toggle="collapse" href="#id_displaycontainer" role="button" aria-expanded="true" aria-controls="id_displaycontainer" class="btn btn-icon me-3 icons-collapse-expand stretched-link fheader " id="collapseElement-6">

<a class="btn btn-link p-0 me-2 icon-no-margin help-icon" role="button" data-bs-container="body" data-bs-toggle="popover" data-bs-custom-class="help-popover" data-bs-placement="right" data-bs-content="<div class="no-overflow"><p>If enabled, a student's name and picture will be shown on-screen during the attempt, and on the review screen, making it easier to check that the student is logged in as themselves in an invigilated (proctored) exam.</p>
</div> " data-bs-html="true" tabindex="0" aria-label="Help" aria-haspopup="dialog">

<a class="btn btn-link p-0 me-2 icon-no-margin help-icon" role="button" data-bs-container="body" data-bs-toggle="popover" data-bs-custom-class="help-popover" data-bs-placement="right" data-bs-content="<div class="no-overflow"><p>This setting specifies the number of digits shown after the decimal point when displaying grades. It only affects the display of grades, not the grades stored in the database, nor the internal calculations, which are carried out to full accuracy.</p>
</div> " data-bs-html="true" tabindex="0" aria-label="Help" aria-haspopup="dialog">

<a class="btn btn-link p-0 me-2 icon-no-margin help-icon" role="button" data-bs-container="body" data-bs-toggle="popover" data-bs-custom-class="help-popover" data-bs-placement="right" data-bs-content="<div class="no-overflow"><p>The number of digits shown after the decimal point when displaying the marks for individual questions.</p>
</div> " data-bs-html="true" tabindex="0" aria-label="Help" aria-haspopup="dialog">
Show more...

<a data-bs-toggle="collapse" href="#id_sebcontainer" role="button" aria-expanded="true" aria-controls="id_sebcontainer" class="btn btn-icon me-3 icons-collapse-expand stretched-link fheader " id="collapseElement-7">

<a class="btn btn-link p-0 me-2 icon-no-margin help-icon" role="button" data-bs-container="body" data-bs-toggle="popover" data-bs-custom-class="help-popover" data-bs-placement="right" data-bs-content="<div class="no-overflow"><p>If enabled, students can only attempt the quiz using the Safe Exam Browser.
The available options are:</p>

<ul>
<li>No
<br />Safe Exam Browser is not required to attempt the quiz.</li>
<li>Yes – Use an existing template
<br />A template for the configuration of Safe Exam Browser can be used. Templates are managed in the site administration. Your manual settings overwrite the settings in the template.</li>
<li>Yes – Configure manually
<br />No template for the configuration of Safe Exam Browser will be used. You can configure Safe Exam Browser manually.</li>
<li>Yes – Upload my own config
<br />You can upload your own Safe Exam Browser configuration file. All manual settings and the use of templates will be disabled.</li>
<li>Yes – Use SEB client config
<br />No configurations of Safe Exam Browser are on the Moodle side. The quiz can be attempted with any configuration of Safe Exam Browser.</li>
</ul>
</div> " data-bs-html="true" tabindex="0" aria-label="Help" aria-haspopup="dialog">

<a class="btn btn-link p-0 me-2 icon-no-margin help-icon" role="button" data-bs-container="body" data-bs-toggle="popover" data-bs-custom-class="help-popover" data-bs-placement="right" data-bs-content="<div class="no-overflow"><p>The settings in the selected config template will be used for the configuration of the Safe Exam Browser while attempting the quiz. You may overwrite the settings in the template with your manual settings.</p>
</div> " data-bs-html="true" tabindex="0" aria-label="Help" aria-haspopup="dialog">

<a class="btn btn-link p-0 me-2 icon-no-margin help-icon" role="button" data-bs-container="body" data-bs-toggle="popover" data-bs-custom-class="help-popover" data-bs-placement="right" data-bs-content="<div class="no-overflow"><p>Please upload your own Safe Exam Browser config file for this quiz.</p>
</div> " data-bs-html="true" tabindex="0" aria-label="Help" aria-haspopup="dialog">

<a class="btn btn-link p-0 me-2 icon-no-margin help-icon" role="button" data-bs-container="body" data-bs-toggle="popover" data-bs-custom-class="help-popover" data-bs-placement="right" data-bs-content="<div class="no-overflow"><p>If enabled, a button for Safe Exam Browser download will be shown on the quiz start page.</p>
</div> " data-bs-html="true" tabindex="0" aria-label="Help" aria-haspopup="dialog">

<a class="btn btn-link p-0 me-2 icon-no-margin help-icon" role="button" data-bs-container="body" data-bs-toggle="popover" data-bs-custom-class="help-popover" data-bs-placement="right" data-bs-content="<div class="no-overflow"><p>In this field you can enter the link to quit SEB. It is used on an "Exit Safe Exam Browser" button on the page that appears after the exam is submitted. When clicking the button or the link placed wherever you want to put it, it is possible to quit SEB without having to enter a quit password. For an HTTPS site, the quit link has to start with https://. If no link is entered, then the "Exit Safe Exam Browser" button does not appear and there is no link set to quit SEB.</p>
</div> " data-bs-html="true" tabindex="0" aria-label="Help" aria-haspopup="dialog">

<a class="btn btn-link p-0 me-2 icon-no-margin help-icon" role="button" data-bs-container="body" data-bs-toggle="popover" data-bs-custom-class="help-popover" data-bs-placement="right" data-bs-content="<div class="no-overflow"><p>If enabled, users have to confirm quitting of SEB when a quit link is detected.</p>
</div> " data-bs-html="true" tabindex="0" aria-label="Help" aria-haspopup="dialog">

<a class="btn btn-link p-0 me-2 icon-no-margin help-icon" role="button" data-bs-container="body" data-bs-toggle="popover" data-bs-custom-class="help-popover" data-bs-placement="right" data-bs-content="<div class="no-overflow"><p>If enabled, users can quit SEB with the "Quit" button in the SEB task bar or by pressing the keys Ctrl-Q or by clicking the main browser window close button.</p>
</div> " data-bs-html="true" tabindex="0" aria-label="Help" aria-haspopup="dialog">

<a class="btn btn-link p-0 me-2 icon-no-margin help-icon" role="button" data-bs-container="body" data-bs-toggle="popover" data-bs-custom-class="help-popover" data-bs-placement="right" data-bs-content="<div class="no-overflow"><p>This password is prompted when users try to quit SEB with the "Quit" button, Ctrl-Q or the close button in the main browser window. If no quit password is set, then SEB just prompts "Are you sure you want to quit SEB?".</p>
</div> " data-bs-html="true" tabindex="0" aria-label="Help" aria-haspopup="dialog">

<a class="btn btn-link p-0 me-2 icon-no-margin help-icon" role="button" data-bs-container="body" data-bs-toggle="popover" data-bs-custom-class="help-popover" data-bs-placement="right" data-bs-content="<div class="no-overflow"><p>If enabled, page reload is allowed (reload button in SEB task bar, browser tool bar, iOS side slider menu, keyboard shortcut F5/cmd+R). Note that offline caching may break if a user tries to reload a page without an internet connection.</p>
</div> " data-bs-html="true" tabindex="0" aria-label="Help" aria-haspopup="dialog">

<a class="btn btn-link p-0 me-2 icon-no-margin help-icon" role="button" data-bs-container="body" data-bs-toggle="popover" data-bs-custom-class="help-popover" data-bs-placement="right" data-bs-content="<div class="no-overflow"><p>If enabled, a task bar appears at the bottom of the SEB browser window. The task bar is required to display items such as Wi-Fi control, reload button, time and keyboard layout.</p>
</div> " data-bs-html="true" tabindex="0" aria-label="Help" aria-haspopup="dialog">

<a class="btn btn-link p-0 me-2 icon-no-margin help-icon" role="button" data-bs-container="body" data-bs-toggle="popover" data-bs-custom-class="help-popover" data-bs-placement="right" data-bs-content="<div class="no-overflow"><p>If enabled, a reload button is displayed in the SEB task bar, allowing the current web page to be reloaded.</p>
</div> " data-bs-html="true" tabindex="0" aria-label="Help" aria-haspopup="dialog">

<a class="btn btn-link p-0 me-2 icon-no-margin help-icon" role="button" data-bs-container="body" data-bs-toggle="popover" data-bs-custom-class="help-popover" data-bs-placement="right" data-bs-content="<div class="no-overflow"><p>If enabled, the current time is displayed in the SEB task bar.</p>
</div> " data-bs-html="true" tabindex="0" aria-label="Help" aria-haspopup="dialog">

<a class="btn btn-link p-0 me-2 icon-no-margin help-icon" role="button" data-bs-container="body" data-bs-toggle="popover" data-bs-custom-class="help-popover" data-bs-placement="right" data-bs-content="<div class="no-overflow"><p>If enabled, the current keyboard layout is shown in the SEB task bar. It allows you to switch to other keyboard layouts, which have been enabled in the operating system.</p>
</div> " data-bs-html="true" tabindex="0" aria-label="Help" aria-haspopup="dialog">

<a class="btn btn-link p-0 me-2 icon-no-margin help-icon" role="button" data-bs-container="body" data-bs-toggle="popover" data-bs-custom-class="help-popover" data-bs-placement="right" data-bs-content="<div class="no-overflow"><p>If enabled, a Wi-Fi control button appears in the SEB task bar. The button allows users to reconnect to Wi-Fi networks which have previously been connected to.</p>
</div> " data-bs-html="true" tabindex="0" aria-label="Help" aria-haspopup="dialog">

<a class="btn btn-link p-0 me-2 icon-no-margin help-icon" role="button" data-bs-container="body" data-bs-toggle="popover" data-bs-custom-class="help-popover" data-bs-placement="right" data-bs-content="<div class="no-overflow"><p>If enabled, the audio control icon is shown in the SEB task bar.</p>
</div> " data-bs-html="true" tabindex="0" aria-label="Help" aria-haspopup="dialog">

<a class="btn btn-link p-0 me-2 icon-no-margin help-icon" role="button" data-bs-container="body" data-bs-toggle="popover" data-bs-custom-class="help-popover" data-bs-placement="right" data-bs-content="<div class="no-overflow"><p>If enabled, audio is initially muted when starting SEB.</p>
</div> " data-bs-html="true" tabindex="0" aria-label="Help" aria-haspopup="dialog">

<a class="btn btn-link p-0 me-2 icon-no-margin help-icon" role="button" data-bs-container="body" data-bs-toggle="popover" data-bs-custom-class="help-popover" data-bs-placement="right" data-bs-content="<div class="no-overflow"><p>If enabled, users will be asked to grant access to the camera for SEB before the exam session is started. In macOS 12/iOS 15 or later, disabling this setting prevents web applications from accessing the camera i.e. video recording via WebRTC will not be possible.</p>
</div> " data-bs-html="true" tabindex="0" aria-label="Help" aria-haspopup="dialog">

<a class="btn btn-link p-0 me-2 icon-no-margin help-icon" role="button" data-bs-container="body" data-bs-toggle="popover" data-bs-custom-class="help-popover" data-bs-placement="right" data-bs-content="<div class="no-overflow"><p>If enabled, users will be asked to grant access to the microphone for SEB before the exam session is started. In macOS 12/iOS 15 or later, disabling this setting prevents web applications from accessing the microphone i.e. audio recording via WebRTC will not be possible.</p>
</div> " data-bs-html="true" tabindex="0" aria-label="Help" aria-haspopup="dialog">

<a class="btn btn-link p-0 me-2 icon-no-margin help-icon" role="button" data-bs-container="body" data-bs-toggle="popover" data-bs-custom-class="help-popover" data-bs-placement="right" data-bs-content="<div class="no-overflow"><p>If enabled, spell checking in the SEB browser is allowed.</p>
</div> " data-bs-html="true" tabindex="0" aria-label="Help" aria-haspopup="dialog">

<a class="btn btn-link p-0 me-2 icon-no-margin help-icon" role="button" data-bs-container="body" data-bs-toggle="popover" data-bs-custom-class="help-popover" data-bs-placement="right" data-bs-content="<div class="no-overflow"><p>If enabled, URLs will be filtered when loading web pages. The filter set has to be defined below.</p>
</div> " data-bs-html="true" tabindex="0" aria-label="Help" aria-haspopup="dialog">

<a class="btn btn-link p-0 me-2 icon-no-margin help-icon" role="button" data-bs-container="body" data-bs-toggle="popover" data-bs-custom-class="help-popover" data-bs-placement="right" data-bs-content="<div class="no-overflow"><p>If enabled, embedded resources will also be filtered using the filter set.</p>
</div> " data-bs-html="true" tabindex="0" aria-label="Help" aria-haspopup="dialog">

<a class="btn btn-link p-0 me-2 icon-no-margin help-icon" role="button" data-bs-container="body" data-bs-toggle="popover" data-bs-custom-class="help-popover" data-bs-placement="right" data-bs-content="<div class="no-overflow"><p>A text field which contains the allowed filtering expressions for the allowed URLs. Use of the wildcard char '*' is possible. Examples for expressions: 'example.com' or 'example.com/stuff/*'. 'example.com' matches 'example.com', 'www.example.com' and 'www.mail.example.com'. 'example.com/stuff/*' matches all requests to any subdomain of 'example.com' that have 'stuff' as the first segment of the path.</p>
</div> " data-bs-html="true" tabindex="0" aria-label="Help" aria-haspopup="dialog">

<a class="btn btn-link p-0 me-2 icon-no-margin help-icon" role="button" data-bs-container="body" data-bs-toggle="popover" data-bs-custom-class="help-popover" data-bs-placement="right" data-bs-content="<div class="no-overflow"><p>A text field which contains the filtering expressions for allowed URLs in a regular expression (Regex) format.</p>
</div> " data-bs-html="true" tabindex="0" aria-label="Help" aria-haspopup="dialog">

<a class="btn btn-link p-0 me-2 icon-no-margin help-icon" role="button" data-bs-container="body" data-bs-toggle="popover" data-bs-custom-class="help-popover" data-bs-placement="right" data-bs-content="<div class="no-overflow"><p>A text field which contains the filtering expressions for the blocked URLs. Use of the wildcard char '*' is possible. Examples for expressions: 'example.com' or 'example.com/stuff/*'. 'example.com' matches 'example.com', 'www.example.com' and 'www.mail.example.com'. 'example.com/stuff/*' matches all requests to any subdomain of 'example.com' that have 'stuff' as the first segment of the path.</p>
